overview.Module Title: Principles of Course and Materials Design

sections.Aims and Fit of Module: The main aims of the module are to: • Introduce some of the main research, theorizing and practice involved in the evaluation and design of curricula for English language education • Examine each of the main levels of activity involved in curriculum design, i.e., needs analysis, situation analysis, course design, material design, syllabus design and materials evaluation and adaptation • Identify relevant academic concepts for each of these areas studied • Raise awareness of factors that are crucial to effective teaching • Understand and use the practical procedures and principals involved
sections.Learning outcomes: Students completing the module successfully should: CODE OUTCOME A Understand the main research, theory and practice involved in the design and evaluation of curricula for English language education B Have a good knowledge about each of the main levels of activity involved in curriculum design, i.e., needs analysis, situation analysis, course design, material design, syllabus design and materials evaluation and adaptation C Acquire relevant academic concepts for these areas D Be aware of the key factors that are crucial to effective teaching E Be able to apply theoretical principles in real course and material designing practice
sections.Method of teaching and learning: The teaching sessions are divided into two components: lectures and tutorials/workshops.
